title: Past continuous y past simple: when / while

rule.title: Past continuous vs past simple
rule.explanation:
El past continuous («was» / «were» + «-ing») describe una acción que estaba en curso en un momento del pasado:
- «At nine I was sitting on the bus.»
- «What were you doing at eight? — I was having breakfast.»

Lo combinamos con el past simple para contar que algo interrumpió esa acción. La acción larga va en continuous y la corta, en simple. «When» suele ir con la corta:
- «I was walking to the bus stop when it started to rain.»
- «When Helen called, I was cooking.»

Con «while» solemos usar el continuous:
- «While I was opening it, the wind broke it.»

Dos acciones largas a la vez van las dos en continuous:
- «I was cooking while Sam was watching TV.»

Para una serie de acciones cortas, una detrás de otra, se usa solo el past simple:
- «I got up, had a shower and went to work.»

Ojo: los verbos de estado («know», «want», «like», «need»…) no van en continuous tampoco en pasado: «I knew the answer» (nunca «I was knowing»).

rows: I was walking when it started to rain.

sets.instructions: Completa con el past continuous o el past simple del verbo entre paréntesis.

items.sentence: I ___ to the bus stop when it started to rain. (walk)
While I was ___ my umbrella, the wind broke it. (open)
When I was getting on the bus, a man ___ into me. (run)
What ___ you doing when Helen called?
Helen ___ talking to a client all morning.
They ___ working when I arrived. They were having coffee.
It was ___ when I left home. (rain)
When the phone ___, I was in the shower. (ring)
I ___ TV when the lights went out. (watch)
Sam was cooking while Priya ___ a book. (read)
items.explanation: Dos acciones largas: las dos en continuous.

items.sentence: What were you doing at ten? — I ___. (sleep)
I got up, ___ a shower and went to work. (have)
items.explanation: Serie de acciones cortas: past simple.

items.sentence: She ___ the answer, so she said it quickly. (know)
Were you sleeping when I called? — No, I ___.

items.question: Estaba caminando cuando empezó a llover.
options: I was walking when it started to rain.
I walked when it was starting to rain.
items.explanation: Acción larga en continuous, corta en simple.

items.question: ¿Qué estabas haciendo a las nueve?
options: What were you doing at nine?
What did you doing at nine?

items.question: Mientras cocinaba, llegó Sam.
options: While I was cooking, Sam arrived.
While I cooked, Sam was arriving.

items.question: Sabía la respuesta.
options: I knew the answer.
I was knowing the answer.

items.question: No estaban trabajando.
options: They weren't working.
They wasn't working.

items.question: Me levanté, desayuné y salí.
options: I got up, had breakfast and left.
I was getting up, having breakfast and leaving.
items.explanation: Serie de acciones cortas: past simple.

items.question: Cuando sonó el teléfono, estaba en la ducha.
options: When the phone rang, I was in the shower.
When the phone was ringing, I was in the shower.

items.question: Llovía cuando salí de casa.
options: It was raining when I left home.
It rained when I was leaving home.

items.question: ¿Estabas durmiendo? — Sí.
options: Were you sleeping? — Yes, I was.
Were you sleeping? — Yes, I were.

items.question: Yo cocinaba mientras Sam veía la tele.
options: I was cooking while Sam was watching TV.
I cooked while Sam watched TV was.

sets.instructions: Une las dos frases con «when» o «while», o corrige el error.

items.source: I was having a shower. The phone rang.
answers: I was having a shower when the phone rang
When the phone rang, I was having a shower

items.source: Sam was sleeping. Priya was working.
answers: Sam was sleeping while Priya was working
While Sam was sleeping, Priya was working

items.source: We were walking home. It started to snow.
answers: We were walking home when it started to snow
When it started to snow, we were walking home

items.source: What did you doing at eight?
answers: What were you doing at eight

items.source: While I walked home, I was seeing an accident.
answers: While I was walking home, I saw an accident
items.explanation: Acción larga en continuous, corta en simple.

items.source: When I arrived, Helen talked on the phone.
answers: When I arrived, Helen was talking on the phone

items.source: Estaba esperando el autobús cuando empezó a llover.
answers: I was waiting for the bus when it started to rain

items.source: Mientras yo cocinaba, Sam llegó a casa.
answers: While I was cooking, Sam arrived home
While I was cooking, Sam got home
While I was cooking, Sam came home

items.source: Cuando llamaste, estaba en la ducha.
answers: When you called, I was in the shower
When you phoned, I was in the shower

items.source: Estaba leyendo cuando se fue la luz.
answers: I was reading when the lights went out
I was reading when the power went out

items.answer: I was walking to the bus stop
What were you doing at nine?
She was talking to a client
While I was cooking, the phone rang
